name: claude
description: Use Claude Code from Codex for stewarded frontend implementation, visual explainers, and Claude Fable 5 second opinions.

interface.longDescription: Every way Codex spends Claude tokens, in one place. Claude Opus 5 takes the first implementation pass on browser-visible product UI and gives visual direction on polished single-file HTML explainers; Claude Fable 5 answers as Oracle when a decision needs a second opinion. All three verify the answering model against Claude Code's own usage metadata and fail closed rather than pass off a fallback. Codex remains responsible for scope, diff review, cleanup, verification, and shipping judgment.
